top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on paved high-altitude lakeside highways, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic America's Most Beautiful Bike Ride's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
56ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.

Road-specific control matters at America's Most Beautiful Bike Ride. Practice on paved high-altitude lakeside highways: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 72 miles.
At America's Most Beautiful Bike Ride, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
72 miles on paved high-altitude lakeside highways burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of America's Most Beautiful Bike Ride. Train it until it feels boring.
Base fitness for America's Most Beautiful Bike Ride. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Varied gradients on paved high-altitude lakeside highways demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,024ft of climbing on paved high-altitude lakeside highways does to your power file on race day.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on paved high-altitude lakeside highways can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at America's Most Beautiful Bike Ride. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for America's Most Beautiful Bike Ride's 72 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at America's Most Beautiful Bike Ride. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 72 miles of paved high-altitude lakeside highways in Stateline, Nevada, USA.
